svg.title: F4: Matrix Orthogonality Drift and SVD Projection
svg.desc: model_scenario: Numerical matrix orthogonality drift under perturbation and SVD re-orthogonalization restoring det(R) = 1. Labelled model_scenario.
svg.text: Matrix integration drift vs SVD projection:
SVD projection restores R^T R = I and det(R) = +1 without shearing.
